title: Entire SK council in Sarangani resigns over canceled polls

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, SOUTH COTABATO, Philippines — An entire 10-member Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) council in Malungon, Sarangani province has resigned altogether—declining two more years in office as a result of the postponement of the Barangay and SK Elections (BSKE)—saying they can’t keep postponing their personal and career plans. Last September, President Marcos signed Republic Act No. 12326, postponing the BSKE set for Nov. 2 to the second Monday of November 2028, effectively extending the term of current barangay and SK officials by two more years.
